## Highlights

**Flashwatch 2 is a rebuild of what you see and of how sure it is.**

- **A new overlay: the enemy team.** All five enemies down the right edge, every
  spell they took, drawn like the game's own ability icons -- greyed with a sweep
  and the seconds left while down, plain while up, a green ring as they come
  back. Enemies with nothing down fade out. No panel, nothing in front of the
  game. Your old display is still one click away in *Display*.
- **It only wakes up where you want it.** Summoner's Rift and the Practice Tool
  by default; ARAM, Arena and the rotating modes are off and can be switched on
  in *Settings -> Game modes*. In a mode that is off it captures nothing at all.
- **Cooldowns for each enemy, exactly.** Flashwatch now reads the game's own
  local data feed (the one Riot provides for companion apps): it knows the five
  enemies and their two spells from the first second, their boots, their rune
  trees and their level. A Flash is 300 s on the jungler without Inspiration and
  254 s on the mid laner with Cosmic Insight -- not one guess for everybody.
- **Fixed: wrong cooldowns.** Runes and boots were applied as an old-style
  percentage, so every Cosmic Insight timer came back about 8 s early, and the
  built-in table still had Teleport at 360 s (300 s today) and Cleanse at 210 s
  (240 s). Cooldowns now come from Riot's data for the current patch, and
  Unleashed Teleport follows the caster's level after 10:00.
- **Fixed: missed spells.** A chat area drawn too narrow cut every line off
  before the spell's name. It is now widened to fit whole lines, and again
  whenever a line runs into its edge. Lines about your own team, or about a
  spell the enemy did not take, are refused instead of timed.
- **Lighter at the start of a game**, when the chat is still empty: looking for
  it backs off instead of reading the screen several times a second.

Your settings carry over; the display and the theme are switched to the new
ones once, and everything else stays as you left it.
